    The Loop

    A story game in five acts · 2027–2030 · about being the human in the loop

    You are the human in the loop. It is January 2027 and you are a junior analyst at a logistics company, the week a new AI called ChatGPX arrives. By February you have $480, an old laptop, three stars on a freelance site, and neighbours who knock at night. Rent is $1,800.

    The bar across the top tells you, at a glance, whether you will have the rent on the day it is due. What you do about it is up to you.

    Fiction about AI catastrophe, for adults. Made for a computer screen.

    THE ACTS

    Based on research by Dan Hendrycks (Natural Selection Favors AIs over Humans), Daniel Kokotajlo (AI 2027), and Max Tegmark (Life 3.0).
